documentNotes.statement: The original sheets print both Russian and English versions of the same three questions. Both are retained together. No observation answer key is included in the three observation photographs. A general sky map from the same-year archive practical directory is included as supplementary material: its coordinate/date grid and sky coverage are compatible with questions8/10, but the photograph has no task-specific identification proving it is the exact map originally supplied for the observation round. The printed Cygnus chart for question9 and emblem referenced by question10 are retained.

transcription.notes: Single Astra reader personally read all three original bilingual observation photographs, preserving independent whole questions8–10, blank response fields and full ephemerides. All three practical answer photographs inspected for observation key coverage; they concern6/7 only. No separate checker. Primary single-photo catalogue lists only question8, while separate original observational3 explicitly prints independent9/10. Internal numbers normalized1–3; stable IDs and titles preserve8–10; publisher display overlays required. Revision2 personally reads same-year pract7 general sky map and includes original raster bytes with explicit uncertain exact-handout identity. Original r1 artifacts/manifest snapshot retained unchanged.

problems.statement:
Используя таблицу эфемерид, нанесите на карту текущее положение Луны, Юпитера и Солнца. Определите созвездия, в которых они расположены. Название созвездия запишите в трехбуквенном латинском обозначении.

Draw the current positions of Moon, Jupiter, and Sun at the map. Write the constellations in which they are situated. The names of constellations must be written in short Latin form (only three letters). Use the table of the ephemeredes.

| | Созвездие, в котором расположен объект / Constellation of the current position of the object |
|---|---|
| Луна / Moon | |
| Юпитер / Jupiter | |
| Солнце / Sun | |

![](p8-archive-map)

figures.alt: General polar star map with right ascension, declination, constellation boundaries and month/date scales.

problems.statement:
Перед Вами созвездие Cygnus, в котором указаны звезды до 5-й звездной величины. Укажите лишние звёзды или места, где звёзд не хватает.

You see the Cygnus constellation with the stars not fainter then 5 magnitude. Mark the wrong stars or positions of missing stars.

![](p9-cygnus)

Используя карту звёздного неба, определите среднесолнечное (астрономическое) время сегодняшней верхней кульминации звезды «α» созвездия, изображённого на эмблеме XV IAO.

Using the sky map determine the astronomical (mean solar) time of today’s upper culmination of «α» star of the constellation which is used at the emblem of XV IAO.

![](p10-emblem)

$T = \underline{\hspace{2cm}}\;\mathrm{h}\;\underline{\hspace{2cm}}\;\mathrm{m}$
